reuse.why: Extracts clearAccountBankLink and reuses it from unlinkAccount and the takeover path, and reuses findOrCreateBank/syncAccount/the Akahu balance branch, but Fintegra's link and download functions are new copies of existing provider bodies.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount copies the upgrade-or-insert/sync/notify body of the other link handlers, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the assert-then-unlink preamble is pasted into all six handlers.

placement.why: Guards and unlink helpers live in accounts/app.ts next to the handlers and unlinkAccount, download in sync.ts, config and types in their usual modules.

scope.why: Changes and the sizeable test suite all trace to the four steps.

maintainability.why: The check is a clean function returning holder ids and the local unlink is shared with unlinkAccount, but the six-way handler copy grows and each handler must remember to call both the check and unlinkReplacedAccounts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All handlers call assertBankAccountCanBeLinked, and the takeover reuses clearAccountBankLink shared with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra link/download bodies and the per-handler preamble are open copies (the download only swaps let for const), not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts gains replaceExistingLink plus a closed-target branch and a replace-allowed branch over steps 3-4; no handler bypasses it.
